summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return disclosing open-market share repurchases of its Class A ordinary shares during May–June 2026. The repurchases, priced between approximately USD 6.55 and USD 7.25 per share, are small accretive buybacks totaling roughly 0.09% or less of existing shares each day; all are repurchased for cancellation but not yet cancelled at the closing balance date. The board appears to authorize these trades without naming an advisor, as this is a routine share buyback disclosure under Hong Kong listing rules. Investors should watch the pace of ongoing buybacks as a signal of capital return commitment.
